# Chronos Forecasting Pipeline

- `src/chronos_forecasting/config.py`: immutable TOML configuration.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/data.py`: CSV normalization, validation, and splitting.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/backend.py`: lazy AutoGluon integration boundary.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/artifacts.py`: holdout evaluation and artifact writes.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/plotting.py`: optional static forecast visualization.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/service.py`: end-to-end orchestration.
- `src/chronos_forecasting/cli.py`: thin command-line interface.
- `tests/`: deterministic offline unit and integration tests.
